Almost ten months after the India-UK FTA, the introduction of a new product category has sparked a dispute. This is over whether bulk Scotch Whiskey should be placed under the lower preferential tariff as per the trade deal. The UK has raised concerns with India after it imposed 162.5% duty on bulk Scotch imports.
Episode 1943 looks at the ongoing dispute, the legalities and implications. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains what it says about ease of doing business in India, our bureaucracy and governance.
